Circuit utilities

Source: R/physics-quantum-circuitutils.R
circuitutils.Rd

Tools of sympy.physics.quantum.circuitutils for circuits given as products of gates or lists of gates: kmp_table() is the Knuth-Morris-Pratt table of a list, find_subcircuit() finds the 0-based position of a subcircuit (or -1), replace_subcircuit() replaces it, convert_to_symbolic_indices() and convert_to_real_indices() switch between numeric and symbolic qubit labels, and random_reduce() and random_insert() remove or insert gate identities. A seed given as a list of integers is used as the sequence of random choices.

Usage

kmp_table(word)

find_subcircuit(circuit, subcircuit, start = 0, end = 0)

replace_subcircuit(circuit, subcircuit, replace = NULL, pos = 0)

convert_to_symbolic_indices(seq, start = NULL, gen = NULL, qubit_map = NULL)

convert_to_real_indices(seq, qubit_map)

random_reduce(circuit, gate_ids, seed = NULL)

random_insert(circuit, choices, seed = NULL)

Arguments

word

A list.

circuit, subcircuit, replace

Circuits.

start, end, pos

Positions (0-based).

seq

A circuit.

gen

A list of symbols to draw new indices from.

qubit_map

A dictionary of symbols and qubit indices.

gate_ids

A list of GateIdentity() objects.

seed

NULL, an integer or a list of integers.

choices

A list of circuits.

Value

A list, a position or a circuit.

Examples

x <- XGate(0); y <- YGate(0)
find_subcircuit(x * y * x, y * x)
#> [1] 1
replace_subcircuit(x * y * x, y)
#> [[1]]
#> X(0)
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> X(0)
#>
